name: eval-case
description: Phase 1 — score ONE gaia-testbench task at ONE level against a candidate bundle (PLAN.md §2.5 / IMPLEMENTATION.md §2.5). Runs as a spawn child (its own cwd) fanned out by evaluate-config. Flow: RUN the adapter (scripts/run_case.py: L2 flowcoder_cli or axi, using the bundle's own flowchart/kb/model) -> JUDGE (command judge.json on the produced artifact) -> WRITE case-result.json (task, level, cost, error, per-criterion). Cost is the ADAPTER's real total_cost_usd (captured to run-result.json), not this child's own session cost. RUN uses continue_on_error so one task's failure still records a result and never aborts the fan-out.

arguments.name: bundle_dir
arguments.description: absolute path of the candidate bundle to score ($1)

arguments.name: workdir
arguments.description: absolute path of this case's workdir ($4)

run.name: RUN_ADAPTER
run.command:
set -u
PY=/home/acer01/axi-assistant/.venv/bin/python
SCRIPTS=/home/acer01/axi-assistant/user-data/autoresearch/dict/configs/optimizer-seed/scripts
"$PY" "$SCRIPTS/run_case.py" "$1" "$2" "$4" "$3" || echo "run_case exited nonzero (adapter error recorded in $4/run-result.json)" >&2
